lead: As climate change accelerates, significant phenomena like El Niño are expected to intensify, leading to unprecedented global temperature spikes and economic impacts. Meanwhile, practical solutions for coping with rising temperatures are becoming increasingly important.

stories.title: The 2026 El Niño Is on Track to Be the Strongest on Record
stories.summary: The upcoming El Niño event in 2026 is projected to be the most powerful in 150 years, potentially causing a global temperature spike and economic losses estimated at $10 trillion by 2032. This phenomenon could exacerbate existing climate challenges, highlighting the urgent need for adaptive strategies.

stories.title: The best fans to keep you cool in 2026 – tried and tested
stories.summary: With the UK experiencing increasingly frequent heatwaves, finding effective cooling solutions has become essential. This guide reviews various fans that can help mitigate the heat without the high energy costs associated with air conditioning, promoting a more sustainable approach to staying cool.
